verdict.rationale: Klaviyo documents an official MCP server that connects to MCP clients such as Claude or Cursor. It offers a recommended remote-hosted mode and a local mode, configurable via query parameters and environment variables, and supports tasks from campaign creation to flow performance reports. The llms.txt confirms headless agent access via the MCP server, and a probe confirms the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as documented.
